what: When a hand goes over the outline-only pill button, a light pill fills in from the inside, from .8x and transparent to 1.01x in .3s, and the two lines (same text or changed text) inside the 30px-high text box shift up 30px so the second line rises (.3s ease) — the border turns light and the text turns dark

options.--fx-fill: Pill color that fills up, default var(--kf-surface)
options.--fx-ink: Text color on hover, default var(--kf-ink)
options.[data-fx-part=box]: Text cell — the first and second span inside stack up and down (if there is no second one, put the same text twice so the first gets cloned)
options.--fx-roll-dur: Distance the text lines shift, default .3s (brand .5s)
options.--fx-out-opacity: End opacity of the first line that slides up, default 1 (City 0 — fades out as it leaves)

from.where: shared.css .hb-btn — original .c-btn__01: ::before scale(.8) · opacity 0 → scale(1.01) · 1 .3s cubic-bezier(.39,.575,.565,1), .c-btn__01-box span top 0/30px → -30px/0 .3s ease, on hover border white and text #143031

shared.css .kz-btn (150×46 pill — a black pill fills in from .9x and transparent to 1.01x over .5s cubic-bezier(0,.3,0,.98), the two lines in a 1.2em cell move up one line over .5s, the first line blurring out) — original c-btn

note: No hover response on touch devices (the original also applies it only inside any-hover)
